construct_toy_data: construct toy test data with images, bounding boxes, labels, masks, and semantic segmentations for augmentation testing
check_shear: check that sheared results match expected results across image, bbox, mask, and segmentation fields
test_shear: test the Shear augmentation transform with horizontal and vertical directions and various magnitude configurations
test_shear_with_autoaugment: test the Shear transform integrated into an AutoAugment pipeline with multiple policy configurations
test_shear_with_polygon_masks: test the Shear augmentation transform using PolygonMasks instead of BitmapMasks for object instance masks
